manifest.name: @across2005/harness-self-evolution
manifest.description: Benchmark-driven self-evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: iterate on a frozen benchmark and accept only when strictly better; real execution remains fail-closed until transactional sandbox support.

bundle.text:
# cordis.patch.yml — DSH bundle patch（loader patch list）。
#
# DSH 方言（已在 0.1.5-rc.2 实测；0.1.6-alpha.1 回归，见 dsh-app-boot 的 anchorInsertedPluginNames）：
# 顶层必须是 YAML 数组；每个元素是「loader patch entry」，其 `insert` 的值必须是
# **挂载行数组** `[{id, name, config?}]`。`name` = 要挂载的 npm 包名（Loader 解析），
# `id` = 后续 patch 层（profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 或 `--patch` overlay）定位该行的目标。
# 若把元数据映射塞进 `insert`，app-boot 会在 `patch.insert?.forEach` 处抛
# `TypeError: patch.insert?.forEach is not a function`，把整个 profile 打挂（ISSUE-01）。
#
# 本文件不是 plugin.json 的翻译 —— 元数据只存在于 package.json 与 .dsh-plugin/plugin.json。
#
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ★ v3.1：本行默认 `disabled: true`，且**不含任何机器绝对路径**
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 为什么：挂载行是**静态**的，而 DSH 树是**每台机器各自**的（`$DSH_HOME` 决定 boot 哪棵，
# managed launcher 可能指向 `<pluginData>/dsh-home`）。出厂写死一台机器的 command/cwd，
# 在别的机器上就指向不存在的文件 —— 插件静默不工作，而用户看到的是一个「装了却没反应」
# 的插件。把易变的那一维（路径）从出厂产物挪到安装期，才是「可复现产物 + 每机部署」
# 的正确切分。
#
# ⚠ 关于「后果有多严重」的更正（2026-09-22 复验）：本文件此前声称路径写错会让
# `failOnStartupError: true` **直接中止整个 profile 启动**。**那是过度声明**，宿主真实
# 语义（dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:2408-2416 / 2513-2515）是：该行**不在**
# `requiredStartupEntryIds`（agent-loop / webserver / modules / connection /
# headless-runner / acp / sdk-jsonrpc-server）里，故其激活失败归入 **optional**，
# 只打印一行 warning，其余条目照常运行。宿主 README 亦明说：
# 「app-boot's startup policy still permits an optional MCP entry to fail without
# aborting the harness.」
#
# 真正会打挂 profile 的是**本文件解析失败**：`parsePatchList` 是 `throw`（:2158-2163），
# 异常一路上抛到 prepareProfile。所以「产出合法 YAML」是本文件的最高不变量，
# 回归测试见 `scripts/test-install-dsh.ps1` + `scripts/test-patch-layer.mjs`。
#
# 决策结论（出厂不写死机器路径）**不变**，只是理由改为上面这条：装错树 = 插件不工作。
#
# 谁来激活：`scripts/install-dsh.ps1` 在**目标树**上解析
# `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/node_modules/@across2005/harness-self-evolution`，
# 把安装位绝对路径、DSH_HOME 以及按树隔离的数据根写进该 profile 的
# `cordis.patch.yml`（DSH 的 patch 语义：id 命中即 `target[key] = value`，逐字段替换，
# 故覆盖行重述整个 `config`）。于是「启动路径」由**安装期按树计算**，不再出厂写死。
#
# 静态自检（不 boot）：
#   dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | Select-String 'mcp-harness-evolution'
# 期望：该行存在、`disabled` 为 false、command/cwd 指向本树安装位。
#
# 为什么不用 ${ENV_VAR} 或相对路径：DSH 的 Loader 只对 `name`（模块标识符）做锚定
# （`./` 或绝对路径 → file URL，以 patch 文件所在目录为基准）；
# `config.command` / `config.cwd` / `config.env` 原样透传给
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的 spawn —— 不解析相对路径、不做 `${ENV_VAR}` 插值
# （app-boot/lib/index.js 的 anchorInsertedPluginNames 只 visit `entry.name`）。
#
# 为什么 env.DSH_HOME 必须由挂载行显式给出：宿主 spawn MCP 子进程时用
# `scrubbedParentEnv()` 丢弃**全部** `DSH_*`（@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess），
# 继承拿不到；只有挂载行 `env` 里的字面量能在清洗**之后**被合并进子进程环境
# （@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 buildChildEnv）。
# 注：插件侧另有「从安装路径推导」兜底档（store/paths.mbt::dsh_home），
# 即使这一项漏配也不会把 user 作用域写进别的树。
- insert:
    - id: mcp-harness-evolution
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      # 默认禁用：由安装器在目标树上启用并注入该树的绝对路径（见上方 v3.1 说明）。
      # 先例：@deepseek-ai/dsh-base 的 `- id: hmr … disabled: true`。
      disabled: true
      config:
        transport: stdio
        serverName: harness-evolution
        # 工具公开名由 serverName 决定：mcp__harness-evolution__<tool>。
        # 下面的 command/cwd/env 是**占位**，安装器的覆盖行会整体替换 config。
        command: 'harness-evolution.exe'
        args: []
        cwd: ''
        env:
          DSH_HOME: ''
          HARNESS_EVOLUTION_HOME: ''
        # 握手/工具发现失败时**拒绝本插件激活**（一行 warning，不中止 harness ——
        # 本行 id 不在 requiredStartupEntryIds 里，见文件头更正说明）。
        # 它的价值是「把 MCP 握手 + 工具发现纳入启动诊断」，而不是「让 boot 失败」。
        # 安装器的覆盖行会原样重述这一项（config 是整体替换，不是深度合并）。
        failOnStartupError: true

declared.name: scan_plugins
declared.description: 扫描 harness 插件并建立档案。支持三种模式：定向重扫（plugin_ids 只扫描指定插件的目录）、路径重定向（target_paths 自定义扫描路径）、全量扫描（默认扫描所有配置的根目录）。返回发现的插件列表及其元数据。

declared.name: get_plugin_metrics
declared.description: 获取指定插件的性能指标，包括调用次数、成功率、延迟、Token 消耗等。

declared.name: propose_evolution
declared.description: 为指定插件生成进化提案。基于性能数据和信号，应用 Matt Pocock 工程原则生成优化建议。

declared.name: execute_evolution
declared.description: 执行已审批的进化提案。协调 Sub-Agent 完成代码生成、测试、文档更新和验证。

declared.name: list_proposals
declared.description: 列出所有进化提案，可按状态和插件过滤。

declared.name: approve_proposal
declared.description: 批准一个进化提案，使其可以被执行。

declared.name: create_sub_agent
declared.description: 创建一个子 Agent 定义文件（Markdown + YAML frontmatter，含名称、职责描述与系统提示词）。scope=plugin 写入插件数据目录（默认）；scope=user 会写入宿主的用户级定义目录（默认宿主 DeepSeek Harness 为 <DSH home>/skills/（$DSH_HOME 未设置时回落 ~/.dsh/skills/）；DSH 无独立 agents 目录，user-scope 定义以 skill 形式落盘，宿主在后续会话经 skills 发现加载）——这跨出插件数据根。注意：创建只是产出定义文件，不等于立即派发执行，宿主何时加载由宿主决定。插件自带的 5 个出厂角色模板随插件 agents/ 目录分发，不在本工具的两个可写目录内。

declared.name: list_sub_agents
declared.description: 列出子 Agent 定义。scope 缺省时同时列出插件数据目录与宿主用户级定义目录（默认宿主 DeepSeek Harness 为 <DSH home>/skills/（$DSH_HOME 未设置时回落 ~/.dsh/skills/））两个作用域；每项含名称、描述、可选的 color/tools、作用域与路径。解析失败的文件会被跳过并在日志告警，不影响其余条目。

declared.name: delete_sub_agent
declared.description: 删除一个子 Agent 定义文件。只删除两个可写目录（插件数据目录的 agents/、宿主的用户级定义目录，默认宿主 DeepSeek Harness 为 <DSH home>/skills/（$DSH_HOME 未设置时回落 ~/.dsh/skills/））里的定义；插件自带的出厂模板不在这两个目录内，天然不受本工具影响。scope 缺省为 plugin。

declared.name: analyze_plugins
declared.description: 分析插件：扫描并/或获取性能指标。mode=scan 仅扫描，mode=metrics 仅获取指标，mode=both 两者都做。支持 plugin_ids 定向重扫和 target_paths 路径重定向。

declared.name: evolve_plugin
declared.description: 进化插件：生成或执行进化提案。action=propose 生成提案，action=execute 执行已审批的提案。

declared.name: manage_sub_agent
declared.description: 管理子 Agent：创建、列出或删除定义。action=create 创建，action=list 列出，action=delete 删除。

declared.name: get_runtime_snapshot
declared.description: 读取运行时快照（纯只读、无副作用）：数据根回显、扫描缓存摘要、提案按状态计数与最近条目、execution.log 尾窗记录、以及数据缺口说明（指标/信号尚未落盘时如实点名并标注覆盖范围——自测量只覆盖本插件自身的工具调用，不把未接线呈现为无活动）。外部可视化（DSH 浮窗/脚本/宿主 LLM）的统一数据入口。

declared.name: record_tool_call
declared.description: 注入一次工具调用性能事件（延迟/成败）到本插件的 monitor，供 get_plugin_metrics 与信号检测消费。用于补齐**其他插件**的生态指标——本插件自身的 tools/call 已自动自测量，无需重复上报。参数体不落盘（只记延迟与成败）。这是 out-of-process 下宿主向 metrics/signals 注入数据的标准入口。

declared.name: record_user_feedback
declared.description: 注入用户对某插件的显式反馈（positive/negative/neutral）。negative 会生成 strong/correction 进化信号。与 record_tool_call 配套，构成缺陷 9 的宿主注入面。

readme.text:
A MoonBit-native plugin that scans, monitors, proposes, and validates evolutions for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin ecosystem. Version 3.2.3. MIT.

This plugin targets DeepSeek Harness. Deployment hinges on how DSH launches the binary, where data is read and written, and which files (patches, manifests, panels) sit alongside the binary.

DSH resolves its home via `$DSH_HOME` (`~/.dsh` by default; a managed launcher may point it
elsewhere). The plugin mirrors that: user-scope sub-agent definitions land under
`<DSH home>/skills/`. Full install, verification, and recovery guidance:
[docs/deploy/deepseek-harness.md](docs/deploy/deepseek-harness.md).

Since v3.0.0 the plugin is **DSH-only**: the earlier claim of MiniMax Code compatibility was a
over-declaration (DSH's own source has no such host concept) and has been removed.

If you are **writing or debugging a DSH plugin** rather than deploying this one, read [docs/dsh-plugin-integration.md](docs/dsh-plugin-integration.md): the host-half / client-half contract, the Lazy-CJS client bundle rule (one stray top-level `export` breaks every plugin in the combo), `DSH_HOME` routing, and the diagnosis order for "Failed to load plugins".

- **Scan** installed plugins across the configured scan roots for the active host
- **Monitor** call latency, success rate, token usage, retry count, and user feedback
- **Identify** strong signals (user override, three consecutive failures, > 20% latency regression) and medium signals (repeated parameter misuses, loop detection, repeated preferences)
- **Propose** benchmark-driven evolutions bound to Matt Pocock engineering principles
- **Approve** is always a human step. `auto_approve` is `false` by default and stays `false` — the only gate against "code changes itself into a wall"
- **Execute** with state machine `pending → approved → executing → completed`; real execution stays fail-closed until a transactional sandbox adapter exists, while failed validation returns the proposal to `pending`
- **Sub-agent factory** persists Markdown + YAML frontmatter definitions; scope `plugin` lives under the plugin's data root, scope `user` lives under `<DSH home>/skills/` (see the deploy guide)

The compiled binary (`bin/harness-evolution.exe`) is a stdio MCP server exposing sixteen tools. The DSH
home resolves in `src/store/paths.mbt::dsh_home`: `$DSH_HOME` when set, else **derived from the plugin's own
install path** (`<X>/profiles/<name>/node_modules/...`), else `~/.dsh`. The user-scope directory is
`<DSH home>/skills` (`HARNESS_EVOLUTION_USER_DIR` overrides it), and the default scan roots follow the same
resolved home (`src/scanner/scanner.mbt::default_scan_roots`). Since v3.0.0 the multi-host abstraction is
gone — DSH is the only target.

```powershell
.\build.ps1 -Task all    # check + test + build; one command rebuilds the binary
```

Build prerequisites: MoonBit `>=0.1.20260904`, MSVC or Clang on Linux/macOS. The current binary in `bin/harness-evolution.exe` is Windows-native; rebuilding on the target platform produces a native binary for that platform.

The complete workspace gate also runs panel/watcher builds and an isolated desktop coexistence smoke without opening a browser:

The plugin stores proposals, metrics, signals, cache, and execution log under `$HARNESS_EVOLUTION_HOME` when set; otherwise it uses the current DSH tree at `<DSH_HOME>/.harness-evolution/v2/` (with the host-compatible `~/.dsh` fallback only when no DSH tree can be resolved). Override the env var to keep dev/test data separate.

Configuration is read in this order, first file that exists wins:

1. `$HARNESS_EVOLUTION_CONFIG` (explicit override)
2. `<cwd>/.dsh-plugin/plugin.json` (self-manifest)
3. `.dsh-plugin/plugin.json` (relative to plugin root)

If none exist the plugin starts with built-in defaults — missing config is not a startup failure.

> **Breaking change (unreleased v2.7.0)**: the legacy `<cwd>/.zcode-plugin/plugin.json` fallback is no longer read. A deployed instance that still carries that file must rename it to `.dsh-plugin/plugin.json` — the contents need no change.

Installing is **per DSH tree**: `dsh plugin add` writes into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>`, and `$DSH_HOME`
decides which tree boots (`~/.dsh` by default — a managed launcher may point it somewhere else). Trees
share nothing: `bundles`, `node_modules`, sessions, and skills are all per-tree, so an install verified in
one tree stays invisible to a host booting another.

Since v3.1 the shipped mount row is **`disabled: true` and carries no machine path** — a literal path for
one machine points at a missing file everywhere else, so the plugin would simply never mount (DSH reports
one `warning` line and keeps booting: `mcp-harness-evolution` is not in the host's
`requiredStartupEntryIds`, so its activation failure is *optional*). The row is written **per tree at
install time**:

```powershell

readme.section: into that tree's profile patch layer; add -DryRun to inspect first

readme.text:
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String 'mcp-harness-evolution'
```

`dsh.profile.bundles` and the patch layers are read at **boot**, so the host must be **restarted** before
the sixteen `mcp__harness-evolution__*` tools appear in a session. The plugin additionally derives its
own tree from the install path, so `create_sub_agent scope=user` lands in `<DSH home>/skills/` even ifpowershell
> pwsh -File scripts/test-install-dsh.ps1     # 7 scenarios; writes only to a temp tree
> ```
